title: Modules, Packages, Build Tools, and Project Structure
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of modules, packages, build tools, and project structure in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 14: Modules, Packages, Build Tools, and Project Structure. Lessons in order: Swift Modules; Swift Package Manager Fundamentals; The Package.swift Manifest; Managing Package Dependencies; Build and Configuration; Swift Command-Line Applications; Subprocesses and System Integration; Environment Configuration; Project Organization; Dependency and API Design; Multi-Platform Package Development; Build Diagnostics and Toolchains.
